reviews.title: Time traveling record book
reviews.review: I read so often that I often forget what books I have read. This helps me to search easily to check if I have read it, want to read it, gave up on it, or have no affiliation with a book. I use another app also but what I like about this one is the option of choosing gave up for a book. The other app has folders that you can create but you can not put a book in a folder unless it is in your read folder or want to read folder. I also like the calendar, it is fun to look and see pictures of the books I have

reviews.title: Adore
reviews.review: I love nearly everything about this app. Only had it about a week before deciding to support and subscribe for a year. The benefit of being able to visually see read/listened to books on a calendar along with tracking the actual time is something I did not know I was missing in my reading logs. It is one thing to say, read in a week and another to know exact times over that week. Getting to log all of your books and see the little covers on the date you read them or completed them has added a little joy to my life. reviews.review: I have been using this app for a few months now and have been loving all the features and statistics it provides. It is very user friendly and I like how you can organize books under different tags and collections. That being said, I really wish they would add a feature where you can reorganize books from the order they were added in. reviews.title: Love the App! But most features are behind a paywall/you have to watch an ad.
reviews.review: I really like Bookmory, I switched over from Bookly after 3 years and over 500 books. But without the subscription the app is borderline unusable and I cannot justify another subscription so I switched. I like that there is no cap on the amount of books you can add but you can only really track time/dates read if you do not want to pay for a subscription. reviews.review: Oh my gosh! I love this app already! So easy to use! I wish there was a way to import my reading data from my other reading tracker, but I am not that upset about it.
